title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
summary: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
summary: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.

title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
summary: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
summary: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
summary: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.
